sections.title: Core words and phrases
sections.description: Flip each card, listen, and create one personal example.

cards.definition: I realised that my phone was missing.
We managed to find another route.
An unexpected problem changed our plans.
I felt relieved when she called.
Call me as soon as you arrive.

tip.title: Recall practice
tip.text: Cover the English term, read the Vietnamese meaning, and retrieve the full phrase from memory.

sections.title: Grammar bridge
sections.description: Master the structures that connect this B1 module to the next stage.

points.title: Past continuous for background
points.function: Use was/were + -ing for an action in progress.
examples: We were waiting for a taxi.

points.title: Past simple for main events
points.function: Use the past simple for the actions that move a story forward.

points.title: Past perfect and sequencing
points.function: Use had + past participle for an earlier past event.
examples: I had left my wallet at home.
After we had eaten, we continued.

tip.title: Accuracy first
tip.text: Notice the verb form in every example, then change the subject or time expression to make a new sentence.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.description: Choose the best answer, then read the explanation.

questions.prompt: While I ___ home, I saw an accident.
questions.explanation: Past continuous gives the background action.

questions.prompt: The film ___ by the time we arrived.
questions.explanation: Past perfect marks the earlier past event.

questions.prompt: ___, we found a safe place to stay.
questions.explanation: Eventually introduces the final result. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.

questions.prompt: She was cooking when the lights ___.
questions.explanation: Past simple marks the interrupting event.

questions.prompt: I felt ___ when I found my passport.
questions.explanation: Relieved describes worry ending. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.

questions.prompt: As soon as he ___, we left.
questions.explanation: Use past simple for the completed event.

tip.title: Use the clue
tip.text: Look for time expressions, the subject, and words before or after the gap before choosing.

sections.title: Listening: The Journey That Went Wrong
sections.description: Follow a short incident and identify its turning point and outcome.

audio.transcript: Two months ago, I travelled to Bristol for an important interview. I had checked the route the night before and left home early. At first, everything went smoothly. However, halfway through the journey, the train stopped because of a signal problem. After waiting for nearly forty minutes, the driver announced that everyone had to change trains. I called the company to explain, expecting them to cancel my interview. Surprisingly, the manager offered to interview me online from a quiet room at the station. A member of staff helped me find one, and the interview began only ten minutes late. A week later, I received a job offer. The experience taught me that a calm explanation can sometimes turn a disaster into an opportunity.

gistQuestions.prompt: What is the main point of the story?
options: A travel problem led to an unexpected solution
gistQuestions.explanation: A delayed train created a problem, but the interview was moved online and succeeded.

detailQuestions.explanation: The train stopped because of a signal problem.

options: The speaker received a job offer
detailQuestions.explanation: A week later, the speaker received a job offer.

tip.title: Listening Tip
tip.text: Track the situation, complication, response and outcome rather than trying to remember every word.

sections.title: Build a spoken answer
sections.description: Answer each question aloud. Aim for a clear answer plus one reason or detail.
questions: Tell a story about a journey that went wrong.
Describe an unexpected but positive event.
What were you doing when you received important news?
sections.sampleAnswer: I was travelling home when the bus broke down. At first, everyone was worried. Fortunately, another driver stopped, and eventually we reached the city safely.

tip.title: Speak in layers
tip.text: Start with a direct answer, add a reason, then give one example or detail.

sections.title: Independent writing
sections.description: Write a short story titled “An unexpected journey”.

prompt.situation: Set the scene, sequence at least three events, and explain the outcome.
prompt.referenceAnswer: I was travelling home when the bus broke down. At first, everyone was worried. Fortunately, another driver stopped, and eventually we reached the city safely.

tip.title: Final check
tip.text: Check verb forms, word order, spelling, and whether every sentence helps answer the task.
